_comment: Pages built by scripts/build_updates.py. One entry per HTML page to generate from a Markdown source in updates/. 'label' is the header eyebrow (defaults to SUPPLEMENTARY NOTE); 'description' is the meta/SEO blurb. title, subtitle, KaTeX, and footnotes are inferred from the content. 'output' overrides the .html name when it differs from the source stem.

pages.label: SUPPLEMENTARY NOTE
pages.description: Fear and Loathing in the Value Stream — a GUM supplementary note on how workplace fear gates the reporting of dysfunction and organizational finance gates its remediation, assembled into a single remediation transfer function.
